_meta.description: Intent taxonomy for the ACTIVE AI Egyptian Arabic / Franco-Arabic / mixed-language real-estate dataset. Action intents (system_action=true) are grounded 1:1 in the real TOOL_REGISTRY defined in src/modules/ai/ai-agent.service.ts of the dalil/ACTIVE codebase, so this dataset trains understanding that maps directly onto capabilities that actually exist and execute in ACTIVE today. Informational/conversational intents are additive, covering customer-facing language that a real-estate sales conversation needs even where no direct system action exists yet.
_meta.action_field_values: Where system_action=true, 'action' is the exact actionType string used by ACTIVE's AutomationService/AiAgentService TOOL_REGISTRY (src/modules/ai/ai-agent.service.ts) — the same token the backend already executes. This is real, not invented.
_meta.risk_and_approval_note: risk_level/read_only/requires_approval mirror each tool's real riskLevel/readOnly flags in TOOL_REGISTRY, and the require_approval action type/ApprovalRequest flow already implemented in automation.service.ts. A 'medium' or 'high' risk write action should never fire from language alone without the confirmation/approval path the app already enforces.
